created_at.description: Timestamp of when the Team was created. Cannot be set by clients.

description.description: Optional. Short description of the team.

name.description: The name of the Team. You can modify this value after the Team is created.

slug.description: The unique identifier of the Team. If a `slug` isn't provided, one is generated based on the `name` field. You can't modify this field after the Team is created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the Team was last updated. Cannot be set by clients.

user_emails.description: Unordered set of emails whose users are members of this team.
